author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0106050 tRNA 2'-O-methyltransferase activity, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31519

The reason for obsoletion is that this term was ambiguous. The correct terms are: 
GO:0106339 tRNA (cytidine(32)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity  and
GO:0106340 tRNA (guanosine(34)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity  >> for TRM7 family

GO:0140386  tRNA (cytidine(4)/adenine(4)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity  >> for TRM13 family 

Annotations are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1fv5FqRUS12vU7ThydUNIgjpOqlTppDL4gdB1IFfUs9A/edit?gid=0#gid=0


3 Reactome
3 SGD
1 InterPro
1 UniRule


Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0106050 tRNA 2'-O-methyltransferase activity

author: deustp01
body:
> GO:0140386 tRNA (cytidine(4)/adenine(4)-2'-O-ribose)-methyltransferase activity

I can't find this term in QuickGO or AmiGO. Is it a new term, or is there an error in the number?

author: pgaudet
body: This term was just created last week; it should take a few days before it's available.

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi,
I'm afraid the term GO:0140386 is not available in the internal curation tools for InterPro yet, I will add it to IPR039044 when possible (I already removed GO:0106050 from this entry).
Best regards,
Beatriz

author: deustp01
body: Reactome fixed; patches will appear in March 2026 release.
